```yaml
name: Update lint config

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1'  # Monday 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update-lint-config:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Run update lint config
        run: make update-lint-config

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check_changes
        run: |
          if git diff --exit-code .golangci.yml; then
            echo "no_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "no_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.no_changes == 'false'
        id: commit
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          branch="update-lint-config-$(date +%s)"
          git checkout -b $branch
          git add .golangci.yml
          git commit -m "chore: update lint config"
          git push --set-upstream origin $branch
          echo "branch=$branch" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.no_changes == 'false'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const title = 'chore: update lint config';
            const body = 'Automated lint config update from upstream.';
            const head = '${{ steps.commit.outputs.branch }}';
            const base = 'main';
            const { data: pr } = await github.rest.pulls.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title,
              body,
              head,
              base,
              draft: false
            });
            console.log(`Created PR #${pr.number}`);
```
